metadata.living_status: Lives with her son and receives family caregiver support

orientation_support.safe_place_reminder: You are at home with your family.
orientation_support.reassurance_message: Fatma Hanım, evdesiniz. Oğlunuz Mehmet sizinle ilgileniyor ve güvendesiniz.

daily_routines.description: Has breakfast with her son Mehmet.
Spends time with simple sewing or fabric-related activities.
Looks at family photos with her caregiver.
Takes evening medication with water after dinner.

core_memories.content: Her son is named Mehmet. He lives with her and helps her during the day.
Her daughter-in-law is named Elif. Elif often prepares tea for her in the afternoon.
She worked as a tailor and enjoyed sewing dresses for her neighbors.
She likes touching colorful fabrics and talking about sewing patterns.
She lives in Üsküdar, Istanbul, with her son Mehmet.
Family photos help her remember Mehmet, Elif and her old sewing shop.

family_members.name: Mehmet Kaya
family_members.description: Primary caregiver who lives with her and supports her daily needs.

family_members.name: Elif Kaya
family_members.description: Often spends time with her at home and prepares afternoon tea.

safety_notes.medical_advice_policy: The assistant must not provide diagnosis, treatment changes or medication dosage decisions.
safety_notes.hallucination_policy: The assistant must only use the information available in this synthetic persona context.
safety_notes.emergency_policy: If the user expresses danger, severe confusion or urgent medical symptoms, the assistant should recommend contacting the caregiver or emergency services.
